HED.prologue: testclash 1.0.0 is the base version of the conflict-companion library, partnered with standard schema 8.5.0. Every testclash version carries the constant Clash-tag scaffold plus at most one probe element shared with testconflict 2.x; each new version deletes the previous probe and adds the next, so every bump is a major version (tag deleted). Probe here: Shared-item, an identical copy of testconflict's Shared-item (compatible share).
